entities.name: UniProt Q06473 COX1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 cytochrome c oxidase subunit 1 (COX1).
551 aa; predicted mass 61.35 kDa; hydropathy indicates a highly hydrophobic, multi-pass membrane protein.
Pfam COX1 domain PF00115 detected at residues 30–470.
Catalytic core subunit of cytochrome c oxidase; contributes to O2 reduction to water and respiratory electron transfer/proton-coupled oxidative phosphorylation.
